# X2, L7 and E1: the clauses that limit what an agent can do.

# readonly removes the actions that change things
! exec metagente check readonly_write.ag
stderr '`file\.write` is not available because `tool file` was declared readonly'
exec metagente check readonly_read.ag
stdout 'No problems found'

# `using` can only name tools the agent declared
! exec metagente check using_unknown.ag
stderr '`using` names `clok`'
stderr 'did you mean `clock`\?'

# `allow` takes domain names, not addresses or URLs
! exec metagente check allow_bad.ag
stderr 'is not a domain name that `allow` can use'
exec metagente check allow_good.ag
stdout 'No problems found'

# secrets are never passed to a tool server
! exec metagente check env_secret.ag
stderr 'can never be passed to a tool server'

-- readonly_write.ag --
agent A
  goal "x"
  tool file "data/" readonly
  accepts go
  on go
    file.write path: "a" text: "b"
    reply "x"
-- readonly_read.ag --
agent A
  goal "x"
  tool file "data/" readonly
  accepts go
  on go
    t = file.read path: "a"
    reply t
-- using_unknown.ag --
agent A
  goal "x"
  tool clock
  accepts go
  on go
    reply think "hi" using clok
-- allow_bad.ag --
agent A
  goal "x"
  tool http allow "10.0.0.1"
  accepts go
  on go
    reply "x"
-- allow_good.ag --
agent A
  goal "x"
  tool http allow "api.example.com" "*.corp.example"
  accepts go
  on go
    reply "x"
-- env_secret.ag --
agent A
  goal "x"
  tool x from mcp "cmd@1.0.0" env "ANTHROPIC_API_KEY"
  accepts go
  on go
    reply "x"
